✨ nginx-ignition | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a user-friendly graphical interface for configuring and managing the Nginx web server, abstracting away the complexity of manual configuration file editing for developers and enthusiasts.
✨ Key Features: • Virtual host management • Stream proxying (TCP, UDP, Unix sockets) • Versatile routing (proxies, redirects, custom code) • Server configuration (timeouts, log level, etc.)
📖 Summary: nginx-ignition is a Go-based web UI for managing the Nginx web server, designed to simplify configuration for developers and enthusiasts. It offers an intuitive interface for tasks like virtual host management, stream proxying, SSL certificate handling, and security configurations, aiming to provide powerful control without manual file editing.
